The '''Silent Sun cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Black Sun territory]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the establishment was frequented by members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.
